title: Corner C5 - Billing UI Visual Spec
summary: Visual spec for the in-app billing settings UI. Plan management, subscription details, usage meters, invoice history, payment method management, plan change flow, cancellation flow.
content:
Corner C5: Billing UI Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For: Bobby (implementation) | Steve (product owner) Location in app: Settings > Billing (in-app, authenticated) Depends on: Stripe integration, Supabase billing tables

Design Context

The billing UI lives inside the Corner app, not on the public marketing site. It uses the dark theme (same as the dashboard) with the Megaboard color system. This is an operational screen, not a sales page. The user already pays. The goal: make billing transparent, upgrades effortless, and cancellation respectful.

Color System (Inherits Megaboard)

Same tokens as the dashboard:

Token Value Usage
bg #0A0F1E Page background
bg-card #0F1525 Section cards
bg-card-hover #141E30 Interactive hover
border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) Borders, dividers
text-primary #F0ECE6 Primary text
text-secondary #8A847C Labels, meta
text-muted #4A5060 Tertiary info
accent #E85D26 Active plan, CTAs
accent-gold #C9A84C Enterprise, premium
success #22C55E Payment success, on-track
warning #F59E0B Approaching limits
danger #EF4444 Overdue, cancellation

Page Layout

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SETTINGS > BILLING                                                        |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                           |
|  +-----------------------------------+  +------------------------------+  |
|  | CURRENT PLAN                      |  | USAGE THIS PERIOD            |  |
|  |                                   |  |                              |  |
|  | Growth                            |  | Agents: 4 / 6               |  |
|  | $3,000/month                      |  | [========------] 67%         |  |
|  | Next billing: Apr 16, 2026        |  |                              |  |
|  | Payment method: ****4242          |  | Storage: 3.2 GB / 10 GB     |  |
|  |                                   |  | [=====---------] 32%         |  |
|  | [Change Plan]  [Update Payment]   |  |                              |  |
|  +-----------------------------------+  | Sessions: 847 / unlimited    |  |
|                                          +------------------------------+  |
|                                                                           |
|  +---------------------------------------------------------------------+  |
|  | INVOICE HISTORY                                                      |  |
|  |                                                                      |  |
|  | Mar 16, 2026   Growth   $3,000.00   PAID     [Download PDF]         |  |
|  | Feb 16, 2026   Growth   $3,000.00   PAID     [Download PDF]         |  |
|  | Jan 16, 2026   Starter  $1,500.00   PAID     [Download PDF]         |  |
|  +---------------------------------------------------------------------+  |
|                                                                           |
|  [Cancel Subscription]                                                    |
|                                                                           |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Grid: CSS Grid, 2 columns on desktop (1fr 360px), single column on mobile. Padding: 24px (desktop), 16px (mobile). Max-width: 960px, centered.

Section 1: Current Plan Card

Container

  • Background: bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Padding: 24px

Content

Plan Name:

  • Font: Syne 800, 24px, text-primary
  • Display: inline-flex with plan tier badge
  • Badge: same as pricing page "RECOMMENDED" style if on Growth, accent-gold if Enterprise

Price:

  • Font: Syne 800, 32px, text-primary
  • "/month" suffix: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-muted
  • Below price: "billed [monthly/annually]" in Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-muted

Billing Cycle:

  • "Next billing: [date]" in Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-secondary
  • If trial: "Trial ends: [date] ([N] days remaining)" in Space Grotesk 400, 13px, warning color
  • Trial progress bar: thin bar (3px) below the date, accent color, showing days elapsed

Payment Method:

  • Card icon (Visa/MC/Amex auto-detected) + "****[last4]"
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 400, 13px, text-secondary
  • Card icon: 24px wide, right-aligned with text

Action Buttons:

"Change Plan" button:

  • Background: transparent
  • Border: 1.5px solid border
  • Color: text-primary
  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 13px
  • Padding: 8px 16px
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Hover: border-color text-secondary, background rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
  • Opens the plan change modal (see below)

"Update Payment" button:

  • Same styling as "Change Plan"
  • Opens Stripe's payment method update flow (hosted by Stripe, not custom UI)

Section 2: Usage This Period

Container

  • Background: bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Padding: 24px

Usage Meters

Each meter is a row:

Agent Slots       4 / 6
[============---------] 67%

Label row: flex, justify-content: space-between

  • Label: Space Grotesk 500, 13px, text-secondary
  • Value: JetBrains Mono 500, 13px, text-primary

Progress bar:

  • Height: 6px
  • Border-radius: 3px
  • Background (track): rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Fill color thresholds:
    • 0-70%: success (#22C55E)
    • 70-90%: warning (#F59E0B)
    • 90-100%: danger (#EF4444)
  • Animation: width transition 400ms ease-out on load

Meters to show:

  • Agent slots: [used] / [plan limit]
  • Storage: [used] GB / [plan limit] GB
  • Concurrent sessions: [count] / [plan limit] (or "unlimited")
  • API calls (if on Scale+): [used] / [plan limit] per month

Margin between meters: 16px

Near-limit warning: When any meter exceeds 90%:

  • Small warning icon (AlertTriangle, 12px, danger) appears next to the label
  • "Approaching limit" text in danger color below the bar
  • Upgrade suggestion: "Need more? [Upgrade your plan]" link in accent color

Section 3: Invoice History

Container

  • Background: bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Overflow: hidden
  • Full width (spans both columns on desktop)

Section Header

  • "INVOICE HISTORY"
  • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 12px, text-muted, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em
  • Padding: 16px 24px
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid border

Table

Header Row:

  • Display: none on mobile (labels inline on each row instead)
  • Desktop: flex row
  • Columns: Date (140px) | Plan (100px) | Amount (120px) | Status (100px) | Action (flex)
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, text-muted, uppercase

Invoice Row:

  • Padding: 14px 24px
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
  • Hover: background bg-card-hover
  • Transition: background 100ms ease

Row Contents:

  • Date: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-primary
  • Plan: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-secondary
  • Amount: JetBrains Mono 500, 13px, text-primary (right-aligned)
  • Status pill:
    • PAID: success bg at 15%, success text, 600 weight
    • PENDING: warning bg at 15%, warning text
    • FAILED: danger bg at 15%, danger text
    • Font: JetBrains Mono 600, 9px, uppercase
    • Padding: 2px 8px, border-radius: 3px
  • Download: "PDF" link in accent color, underline on hover
    • Or: download icon (Lucide Download, 14px, text-muted, hover: text-primary)

Mobile Row Layout:

  • Stack vertically instead of horizontal table
  • Date + Plan on first line
  • Amount + Status on second line
  • Download as a small icon button

Pagination:

  • If > 12 invoices: "Load more" button at bottom
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-secondary
  • No page numbers. Just "Load more."

Plan Change Modal

Triggered by "Change Plan" button.

Modal Container

  • Position: fixed, centered
  • Background: #0A0F1E
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
  • Border-radius: 16px
  • Width: 640px (desktop), calc(100vw - 32px) (mobile)
  • Max-height: 80vh
  • Overflow-y: auto
  • Box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
  • Backdrop: rgba(0,0,0,0.6), backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

Header

  • "Change Your Plan"
  • Font: Syne 800, 20px, text-primary
  • Close button: X icon, top-right, 16px, text-muted, hover text-primary
  • Padding: 24px

Plan Options

  • 4 horizontal option cards (same 4 tiers)
  • Current plan: highlighted border in accent color, "CURRENT" badge
  • Other plans: standard border, clickable

Option Card:

  • Width: equal flex
  • Padding: 16px
  • Border: 1px solid border
  • Border-radius: 10px
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Selected (new choice): border accent color, background accent at 5%
  • Current: border accent color, "CURRENT" pill

Card Content:

  • Plan name: Space Grotesk 600, 14px
  • Price: Syne 700, 20px
  • Key difference from current: "3 more agents" or "Add Megaboard" in accent color, 12px

Upgrade vs Downgrade

Upgrade (selecting higher tier):

  • Summary: "You'll be charged the prorated difference today: $X.XX"
  • CTA: "Upgrade Now" in accent color (primary button)
  • Note: "Your new plan starts immediately."

Downgrade (selecting lower tier):

  • Summary: "Your current plan will continue until [billing date]. Then you'll be moved to [Plan Name]."
  • Warning: "You'll lose access to: [list features being lost]"
  • Features lost in red/warning text
  • CTA: "Downgrade at End of Period" in secondary button style

Confirmation

  • After clicking upgrade/downgrade CTA:
  • Loading spinner (2-3 seconds while Stripe processes)
  • Success: green checkmark + "Plan updated!" + auto-close modal after 2s
  • Error: "Something went wrong. Please try again." with retry button

Cancellation Flow

Trigger

  • "Cancel Subscription" link at the bottom of the billing page
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, danger color
  • No button styling. Deliberate understatement.

Step 1: Confirmation Modal

Headline: "Are you sure?" Body: "Your team has completed [X] tasks this month. You'll lose access to your AI office on [billing end date]."

Stats row (persuasion, not guilt):

  • Tasks completed total: [N]
  • Hours saved (estimated): [N]
  • Active streak: [N] days

Buttons:

  • "Keep My Team" (primary, accent color, large)
  • "Continue to Cancel" (text link, danger color, small)

Step 2: Reason Selection (if they click continue)

Headline: "Help us get better." Options (radio buttons):

  • Too expensive
  • Not getting enough value
  • Switching to another tool
  • Taking a break
  • Other (with text input)

Buttons:

  • "Submit & Cancel" (danger color button)
  • "Never Mind" (text link, returns to billing)

Step 3: Final Confirmation

Headline: "Subscription cancelled." Body: "Your plan remains active until [date]. You can resubscribe anytime before then to keep your data." CTA: "Return to Your Office" (secondary button, returns to dashboard)

Data Retention Notice

  • "Your data will be archived for 90 days after your plan ends. After that, it's permanently deleted."
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-muted
  • Displayed in Step 3

Trial-Specific UI

When the user is on a free trial:

Current Plan card additions:

  • "FREE TRIAL" badge: warning color, JetBrains Mono 700, 10px
  • "Trial ends in [N] days" prominently displayed
  • Countdown: "[N] days remaining" with a thin progress bar
  • "Add Payment Method" CTA (if no card on file yet)
  • "Choose a Plan" CTA replaces "Change Plan"

Trial ending warning (3 days before):

  • Persistent banner at top of billing page
  • Background: warning at 10%
  • Border: 1px solid warning at 20%
  • Text: "Your trial ends in [N] days. Add a payment method to keep your team."
  • CTA: "Add Payment Method"

Trial expired:

  • Dashboard shows read-only state
  • Banner: "Your trial has ended. Subscribe to resume."
  • CTA: "Choose a Plan" (routes to plan change modal)

Responsive

Element Desktop Mobile
Layout 2-column grid Single column stack
Current Plan + Usage Side by side Stacked, plan first
Invoice table Horizontal row per invoice Stacked card per invoice
Plan change modal 640px centered Full width - 32px
Cancel modal 480px centered Full width - 32px

The billing page is where trust is maintained. Transparent pricing, easy upgrades, respectful cancellation. No dark patterns. No hidden fees. No "are you really really sure?" loops. One confirmation is enough. The product should be good enough that people don't want to leave.
